THE WORKSHEET GENERATOR

Math practice maker.

Choose the operation and how far the numbers may go. Solve the sums on screen, or print the sheet — the answer page prints underneath for the grown-up.

Build the sums

Adding and take-away, tuned to a level: sums never climb past the ceiling you pick, and take-away never goes below zero.

Operation
How big may the numbers be?
How many sums?

FOR GROWN-UPS

Solve on screen gives every sum three little answer bubbles — tap the right one and it locks in green; a wrong tap just wiggles and hands the turn back. It is practice, not a test: nothing is stored or scored. Print lays the sums out three to a row on A4 or US Letter with the answer page behind them when the box is ticked, and the picture buttons save PNG files for later. Start within 10 for first counters, and move up when the page starts feeling easy.
